{{Quote|There! Intruder! Bol, call for backup, now!|Commander Vyru, after seeing a member of Havoc Squad in the Separatist base on Mannett Point|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vyru''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was serving in the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] with the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] during the [[Separatist War]], the group's attempt to overthrow the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Vyru and the forces of the cell he commanded on the island of [[Avilatan]] fought against the Republic [[Republic Army|military forces]] backing Ord Mantell's government, and during that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Vyru went to discuss personnel transfers with two other Separatist cell commanders named [[Bol (Separatist)|Bol]] and [[Saphrro]] at the [[Separatist Base]] on [[Mannett Point]], a small island off the coast of Avilatan. However, while the meeting was taking place, a newly recruited [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] [[Havoc Squad]] [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|infiltrated]] the base, [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] Vyru and the other commanders, and obtained the data they had on their forces.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Saphrro, Vyru and Bol are priority-one targets, Sergeant. And recovering their data on separatist cell locations and manpower is too good an opportunity to pass up.|Lieutenant Aric Jorgan, ordering the Havoc Squad sergeant to eliminate Vyru and the other commanders and take their data|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Vyru-TOR.png|thumb|left|150px|Vyru, after spotting the Havoc Squad Sergeant]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Vyru was alive during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the larger conflict, he was part of a [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist Movement]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] that started a conflict<ref name="TOR" /> known as the [[Separatist War]]<ref name="War">{{TORcite|type=message|Date night|Doc}} identified the war as the "Separatist War."</ref> in order to overthrow the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]], which was backed by the Republic.<ref name="TOR" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Vyru had risen to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and was in charge of one of the Separatist cells fighting against the [[Republic Army|Republic's armed forces]] on [[Avilatan]], an island on Ord Mantell. By that time, he had gained a reputation with the Separatists and was viewed by an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Dalern]] as one of the group's greatest heroes. That year, Vyru went to coordinate operations and the transfer of [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] between the various cells at a [[Separatist Base|Separatist base]] on [[Mannett Point]], a small island off the coast of Avilatan. While they were there, the base's security was increased dramatically with additional guards and the installation of a [[Force-field generator|force field generator]] to the entrance of the meeting area.<ref name="TOR" />

However, while Vyru had his meeting with two other Separatist cell commanders named [[Bol (Separatist)|Bol]] and [[Saphrro]], the heavily defended base was [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|infiltrated]] by two members of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] known by the name [[Havoc Squad]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zora]] and a newly recruited [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]], who had come to the base looking for a stolen [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]]. When they did not find the bomb after disabling the [[Force field/Legends|force field]], they interrogated Dalern and learned that Vyru and the others were present at the base. After learning the information, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Aric Jorgan]]<ref name="TOR" /> of [[Ord Mantell Infantry Command]]<ref name="Jorgan">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Hit the Ground Running|Ord Mantell}}</ref> instructed the sergeant to eliminate Vyru and the other separatist commanders as priority-one targets as well as to obtain the information they had about the location and strength of Separatist forces. Despite Vyru and Bol noticing the sergeant approach, they were unable to defeat the individual, and Saphrro failed to delete the data before they were all [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It's because&hellip; well&hellip; Saphrro, Vyru and Bol are here. Three of our greatest heroes who lead us in our glorious&mdash;|Officer Dalern, before being cut off by Captain Zora|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Vyru had [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. During his time as a Separatist cell commander, Vyru was viewed by Separatist Officer Dalern to be one the Separatist Movement's greatest heroes. Vyru's rank gave him a large amount of knowledge about Separatist cells and [[Troop/Legends|troop]] strengths on the island of Avilatan, and he was responsible for coordinating operations and troop transfers with other cell commanders. Vyru and his fellow commanders were important enough to be classified as priority-one targets by Republic Lieutenant Aric Jorgan. Vyru had sufficient skill to use a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] in combat against the recruit sent to eliminate him.<ref name="TOR" />

==Equipment==
While serving the Mantellian Separatists as a commander, Vyru carried a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol and wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of a similar color and appearance to that worn by other Separatists on Ord Mantell during the conflict.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vyru first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. He is featured in "Mannett Point," an early quest available on the planet Ord Mantell for players of the Trooper class. To end the quest the player is required to kill Vyru, along with Bol and Saphrro, the other two Separatist cell commanders with him at Mannett Point. After killing the commanders, the player must retrieve their data on the Separatist cells and forces for the island of Avilatan.<ref name="TOR" />
